item.title: Game reminders that fit your day
item.summary: If you haven't posted by 8pm, Murph checks in. It won't send reminders to a chat that spans time zones, so nobody gets woken up.
item.details: A daily 7pm push is coming with the next app update, with a Notifications page in Settings for your time and your games. If you have a plan or AI usage left, Murph can text you privately too, and it will offer help when you start a game with someone new.
